about: Urban and Architect Solution opened in late 2020 and received its trade license in 2021 from Bogura Municipality, now Bogura City Corporation. Led by Architect Md Mahmudul Hasan. From a desk in Katnarpara to municipal approval sheets, footing details, and homes clients actually move into.

services.title: Architectural Design
services.desc: Floor plans, 3D massing, and working drawings drawn to Bogura City Corporation setback rules.

services.title: Structural Engineering
services.desc: Footing, column, beam, slab, water tank, and septic — RCC framed, checked for seismic safety.

services.title: Interior Design
services.desc: From living room to modular kitchen — measured, lit, and meant to be lived in.

services.title: Approval & Consultancy
services.desc: Bogura Pourashava / City Corporation liaison, digital plot map, and submission until the seal.

services.title: 3D Visualization
services.desc: Exterior and interior renders with a real lighting study — day, dusk, and night.

services.title: Turnkey Construction
services.desc: Agreement-based delivery from foundation to handover, on a stated timeline, with one point of accountability.

faqs.q: What is your approval process for Bogura City Corporation?
faqs.a: We prepare Anumodan Patra, setback and height compliance as per the current BCC rules, a digital plot map, and liaison until the seal.

faqs.q: Do you provide agreement-based turnkey construction?
faqs.a: Yes — fixed timeline, transparent BOQ, site supervision, quality checks, and handover within the estimated time.

faqs.q: What is included in design cost?
faqs.a: Floor plan, 3D, working drawing, structural, electrical and plumbing sheets. Area × rate: Basic 15, Standard 35, Premium 60, Premium Plus 85 BDT per sft.
